items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.r: Most projects are delivered within 1–2 weeks depending on complexity. Ongoing-content clients receive deliverables on a continuous schedule.

items.q: What’s included in the production process?
items.r: Every project includes strategy, scripting, professional filming, advanced editing, and creative direction — with options like drone footage, motion graphics, logo animation, AI visuals, voiceovers, and bilingual delivery (FR + EN).
items.note: [TO CONFIRM: the original answer mentions « strategy » and « AI visuals », while the rule is « no ad strategy or AI service »]

items.q: Do you offer bilingual content (French & English)?
items.r: Yes. Our services are custom, tailored to each client, and bilingual delivery (FR + EN) is included, adapted for the Quebec market to feel natural and effective in both languages.
items.original: Yes. Every package includes bilingual delivery (FR + EN) adapted for the Quebec market to feel natural and effective in both languages.

items.q: What if I’m not sure what type of content my business needs?
items.r: No problem. We guide you toward the right strategy based on your business, goals, and audience — creating content built to attract attention, build trust, and drive action.

membres.texte: My journey began with a passion for visual storytelling. I studied at the Toronto Film School before having to put my studies on hold for financial reasons. Today, I work in construction while building VMM Productions: two worlds that taught me the value of hard work and human relationships. Every production is a chance to bring a vision to life and show the pride behind the work.
With 10 years of experience in film, Renaud brings originality and an instinct for capturing the action. His immersive approach turns spontaneous moments into vivid images.
